text:
ana: Quick sync — token-cost attribution milestone check. Who's owning final event schema & mapping to cost table? We need ownership + PR + canary by EOD Fri.

mike: I can own ingestion + mapping. PR opened but still needs schema from eng-ml. ping @lucy

lucy: on it. I'm finishing model_id normalization and token_type enum. current fields: user_id, request_id, model_id, token_count_total, token_count_prompt, token_count_completion, timestamp, deployment_cluster

randall: analytics needs `token_cost_cents` added (derived) and `latency_ms` for split p95/p99. we'll compute cost using price table by model_id+quantization

lucy: will add `token_cost_cents` as a nullable int and `latency_ms` (int). wondering whether to send both prompt/completion latency or only end-to-end?

ana: both please. prompt/completion latency helps debug cost vs latency tradeoffs.

mike: ingestion schema I expect: event_name=token_usage_v1, payload with those fields. Example event snippet:
```json
{ "event_name": "token_usage_v1", "user_id": "u123", "model_id": "rwd/ggml-13b-q4", "token_count_total": 54 }
```

lucy: looks good. I'll push schema PR today. tagging owners: schema@eng-ml, mapping@eng-platform, analytics@data

platform-bot: CI: schema linter passed for lucy/token-usage-schema

mike: note: ingestion needs to map `model_variant` to price table. I created a small lookup lambda, PR #482

randall: dependency: cost table needs historical prices for earlier model hashes — finance to confirm. @ana can you loop in finance?

ana: looping @mike-finance. Also, can eng-sre confirm no perf regression from added fields? small payload bump but still <1kb

mike: perf test running — should know by 2pm. If any issue, we'll gate with canary.

lucy: code review request: @mike @randall — https://github.com/redwood-inference/schemas/pull/217

mike: reviewing now, will leave comments. plan: merge after LGTM and schedule canary deploy tomorrow 03:00 UTC for 4 hours.

randall: analytics backfill plan: compute token_cost for 14 days once mapping is live. need one-off compute job; can start after deploy.

ana: owners summary: schema=lucy (eng-ml), ingestion+mapping=mike (eng-platform), analytics backfill=randall (data). Milestone: PR + CI by Thu EOD, canary Fri 03:00 UTC, full roll Mon.

lucy: ack, will update schema PR with `prompt_latency_ms` and `completion_latency_ms` fields. Also adding example events in docs.

mike: created a lightweight dashboard for token-cost rollout monitoring — will share link after canary. includes p50/p95/p99 token_cost and latency.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary token-ingestion -> cluster-alpha at 2026-03-20T03:00:00Z

ana: thanks — please drop final ping in #incidents if we see anomalies. Otherwise mark milestone done in project board.

mike: quick question: do we emit `token_source` (cache vs live) now or later?

randall: helpful to have `token_source` for attribution. if that adds complexity, start without it and add via follow-up.

lucy: can include `token_source` as optional string. will add to schema with allowed values ["live","cache","prefetch"]

ana: awesome. last bit: code owners for schema dir updated to lucy,mike. I'll update tickets.

mike: 👍

randall: :thumbsup:

lucy: will update PR and ping again when merged.
